text: He that dasheth: Or, the disperser or hammer
excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel: Or, the pride of Jacob and the pride of Israel
in scarlet: Or, dyed scarlet | flaming torches: Heb. fiery torches
they shall seem: Heb. their show
worthies: Or, gallants | defense: Heb. covering or coverer
Huzzab: Or, That which was established, or, there was a stand made | led away: Or, discovered
of old: Or, from the days that she hath been | look back: Or, cause to turn
for there is none end of the store: Or, And their infinite store, etc. | pleasant furniture: Heb. vessels of desire
